<subject>Re: Document Retention Policy</subject>
<body>
I apologise for the delay in responding. My legal assistant, Sarah Mitchell, is the best contact to address these queries. You can reach her on extension 52467. Please note, we are not making any changes to our policies at this time.

James T. Collins  
14/03/2024 10:15 AM  

To: James T. Collins  
Subject: Document Retention Policy  

----- Forwarded by James T. Collins on 14/03/2024 10:14 AM -----

Emily Harper  
12/02/2024 04:30 PM  

To: James T. Collins  
Subject: Document Retention Policy  

James,  

We have been informed by David Bennett that you are reviewing Halcyon Mutual Bank’s document retention policy. Could you clarify the approach regarding the retention of draft agreements once a transaction is finalised? Our understanding is that the current practice is to dispose of all drafts after closing. We are in the process of formalising our own document retention procedures and want to ensure alignment with Halcyon Mutual Bank’s standards.  

Thank you,  
Emily Harper  
Legal Department  
</body>
